metadata.title: India Sports & Recreation Facility Database
metadata.scope: Pan-India; deep-dive on Kerala plus North/West/South/East regional coverage
metadata.activities: Archery, Boxing Ring & Academy, Cricket Pitch & Turf, Football Turf, Govt & Public Facilities, Horse Riding, Kayaking, Kids Play Arena
metadata.field_note_village_panchayat: Revenue village and gram-panchayat names are rarely published by booking platforms; 'Not stated' where unavailable. Urban facilities show the Municipal Corporation as the local body.
metadata.field_note_fee: 'Not published' = operator does not advertise a rate; confirm on booking. Fees vary by slot/season.
metadata.field_note_ownership: Private = commercial/club-run; Government = state/central/local-body run; Government (PPP) = public-private partnership.
metadata.disclaimer: Compiled reference from publicly listed sources (operator websites, booking platforms, official sports bodies). Not an official government dataset; verify contacts before relying on them.
metadata.districts_table: All states/UTs and districts of India (779 districts across 36 states/UTs), for linking and coverage analysis.
metadata.districts_source: CodingMation/indian-states-districts JSON dataset (states, UTs and districts).
metadata.district_linking: facilities.district_id links each facility to its district where the district could be matched; NULL where the source did not state a district.
metadata.state_by_state: All 28 states and 8 union territories now have a state-by-state research pass (plus the Kerala deep-dive). COMPLETE.
metadata.validation: Validated 2026-10-21: state names OK; district values checked & repaired; 6 districts and 30 aliases added; see validation_log table.
metadata.pool_category: New category 'Swimming Pool' added with two extra columns: pool_type and pool_depth. Gym / Fitness Centre category removed at user request.
